prompt:
The multicolumn section in sections/multicolumn-highlights.liquid currently renders every block, even empty ones, and ignores the existing "Maximum columns" setting. Change its markup to follow the rules below. Keep the {% schema %} block exactly as it is, byte for byte. Inputs (only these are supplied): - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.columns_limit: integer from 1 to 6, never null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each element has the form {"type": "column", "settings": {"title": string or null, "text": string or null}}. Both settings keys are always present. Rules: 1. For each block, its title and text are the setting values with leading and trailing whitespace removed. A null value counts as an empty string. 2. A block is visible when its stripped title or its stripped text is non-empty. Blocks where both are empty are skipped entirely. 3. Only the first columns_limit visible blocks are rendered, in block order. The limit counts visible blocks, not raw block positions. 4. Each rendered block outputs
  • , then

    TITLE

    only if the title is non-empty, then

    TEXT

    only if the text is non-empty, then
    • . 5. If at least one block is rendered, the section outputs two parts: - First,

    HEADING

    , but only when the stripped heading is non-empty. HEADING is the stripped heading. - Then
      …items…
    . N is the number of rendered li items. 6. If no block is rendered, the section outputs nothing at all, not even the heading. 7. All text values (heading, title, text) are HTML-escaped with the escape filter after stripping. 8. Output contains no whitespace or newlines between or around tags. The rendered output must end directly after , with no trailing newline before the schema block. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/multicolumn-highlights.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
